newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Maltese businessmen visit Tunisia to boost trade.
newsitem.headline: Maltese businessmen visit Tunisia to boost trade.

text.p: A group of Maltese businessmen started on Wednesday a three-day visit to Tunisia to discuss ways to boost trade between the two countries, the official TAP news agency reported.

The delegation of businessmen from agro-industry, equipment, communications and computers sectors, is expected to hold meetings with its Tunisian counterpart "to identify opportunities offered by the Tunisian market for Maltese products," the agency said.
Tunisia also expects to benefit from Maltese experience in the field of exports, TAP added.
The agency gave no figures for trade exchange between the two neighbouring Mediterranean countries.
